# How to clear old late charges from patron accounts

For staff helping a patron who still shows a balance from before the end of [[Clearwater Resolution|overdue fines]] on April 1, 2026.

## Before you start

Open the patron's account and look at the charge type on each line. Only lines marked "late" are cleared. Lines marked "lost" or "damaged" stay unless the item came back.

## Clearing the balance

Select the late lines, choose Waive, and use the reason code "policy 2026". Do not waive anything older than 2019 by hand; those balances were already written off.

## Blocked cards

A card blocked only by late charges unblocks automatically once the balance is zero. If the block stays, check for a lost item bill or an expired address, and ask [[Ines Barrow]] if neither applies.
